title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented UND study environments with distinct work settings, technology, and access considerations.

cards.title: Reading Room (The Fishbowl)
cards.subtitle: Chester Fritz Library · second floor
cards.notes: Bring reading or solo drafting to this named second-floor library room; check the floor map on arrival and follow any posted room-use guidance.
cards.short_summary: A named reading room inside UND’s main library.
cards.evidence_claim: UND Libraries’ Chester Fritz Library floor map identifies the Reading Room, also called “The Fishbowl,” on the second floor.
cards.access_notes: Use during Chester Fritz Library open hours and comply with posted room guidance.

cards.title: Chester Fritz Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Chester Fritz Library · first, third, and fourth floors
cards.notes: Choose a listed room for contained work with a partner or small group; consult the floor map and library policy before relying on a room.
cards.short_summary: Map-listed study rooms across several Chester Fritz Library floors.
cards.evidence_claim: UND Libraries’ floor maps list study rooms on the first, third, and fourth floors of Chester Fritz Library.
cards.access_notes: Library policy gives students first-come, first-served priority, with occasional administrative reservations possible.

cards.entity_name: Chester Fritz Library Main Computer Lab
cards.title: Chester Fritz Library Main Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Chester Fritz Library · second floor
cards.notes: Use this lab when an assignment needs a campus workstation, scanner, or uPrint station; save files regularly and arrive with your login ready.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor workstation environment with scanning and printing nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: UND Libraries states that Chester Fritz Library’s main computer lab is on the second floor and includes scanners and a uPrint station.
cards.source_title: Computers and Technology | Chester Fritz Library
cards.access_notes: Computers are first-come, first-served whenever the library is open.

cards.title: Chester Fritz Library Collab Stations
cards.subtitle: Chester Fritz Library · selected study rooms
cards.notes: Plan a group session around a collaborative workstation when shared display and video chat help; ask library staff which study room has one available.
cards.short_summary: Selected study rooms offer mobile collaborative workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: UND Libraries reports three collaborative workstations in some Chester Fritz Library study rooms, each with a 46-inch display and webcam.
cards.source_title: Computers and Technology | Chester Fritz Library
cards.access_notes: Availability depends on the study room; confirm location and room access with library staff.

cards.title: Thormodsgard Law Library Quiet Floors
cards.subtitle: Thormodsgard Law Library · basement and third floor
cards.notes: For quiet legal reading or concentrated writing, use the designated basement or third-floor quiet setting and keep conversations for another floor.
cards.short_summary: Two designated quiet floors in UND’s law library.
cards.evidence_claim: UND Law identifies the basement and third floors of Thormodsgard Law Library as quiet study floors.
cards.source_title: About the Law Library | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: The library lists weekday public hours; law students may use UCard access 24/7.

cards.title: Thormodsgard Law Library Collaborative Floors
cards.subtitle: Thormodsgard Law Library · first and second floors
cards.notes: Bring discussion-based work to the library’s collaborative floors, then move to the quiet floors when the task shifts to individual reading or drafting.
cards.short_summary: Two law-library floors explicitly designated for collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: UND Law identifies the first and second floors of Thormodsgard Law Library as collaborative study floors.
cards.source_title: About the Law Library | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: The library lists weekday public hours; law students may use UCard access 24/7.

cards.title: Thormodsgard Law Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Thormodsgard Law Library · individual and group rooms
cards.notes: Reserve a room for a focused pair or group session, or use an empty room while remaining ready to yield it to a reservation holder.
cards.short_summary: Ten individual and group study rooms with a documented reservation process.
cards.evidence_claim: UND Law lists ten individual and group study rooms at Thormodsgard Law Library and sets a two-consecutive-hour reservation guideline.
cards.source_title: About the Law Library | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Rooms may be used when empty, but reservations take priority; reservations are limited to two consecutive hours without prior permission.

cards.title: Gordon Erickson Music Library
cards.subtitle: Hughes Fine Arts Center · Room 170
cards.notes: Use this specialized library when scores, recordings, or music reference materials support your assignment; confirm its separate hours before walking over.
cards.short_summary: A music-focused library with listening facilities and specialized collections.
cards.evidence_claim: UND Libraries states that Gordon Erickson Music Library has sound recordings, scores, reference materials, and music listening facilities.
cards.source_title: Gordon Erickson Music Library | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: The Music Library has its own posted hours; verify current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Gershman Graduate Center Meeting Rooms
cards.subtitle: Gershman Graduate Center · reservable collaboration space
cards.notes: Graduate students can reserve a meeting room for a planned work session; use the reservation process and keep the purpose tied to graduate education.
cards.short_summary: Reservable meeting rooms in a center dedicated to graduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: UND states that the Gershman Graduate Center has multiple meeting rooms students may reserve for collaboration and that graduate students may reserve space for graduate education.
cards.source_title: Gershman Graduate Center | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Graduate students and the campus community may reserve space for graduate-education purposes; after-hours access uses a UCard.

cards.title: Student Group Collaboration Space
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union · Room 232
cards.notes: Meet in this named Memorial Union collaboration space for student-group planning; use the building map to locate Room 232 and confirm availability first.
cards.short_summary: A named collaboration room in the Memorial Union.
cards.evidence_claim: UND’s Memorial Union building map lists Student Group Collaboration Space in Room 232 and describes the union as having study and meeting spaces.
cards.source_title: Building Map | Memorial Union | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Room availability may be affected by student-group and building scheduling; check with the Memorial Union before planning a meeting.
